bagPolicy.summary: Jiffy Lube Live allows clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutch bags up to 6" x 9". All bags are subject to search upon entry.
allowed: clear plastic bags (max size 12" x 6" x 12")
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: General admission parking is included with your ticket. For easier entry and exit, consider upgrading to Premier or VIP Parking. Early Parking is also available for those who want to arrive before the rush.

rideshare.note: For taxi or rideshare pickup, exit through the front gates and follow the rideshare signs to the designated area a short walk away. Tell parking staff if you are dropping someone off. Drivers collecting guests must arrive 45 minutes before the show ends, before traffic switches to outbound only.

concessions.note: Jiffy Lube Live offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Unique offerings include Koko's Bavarian sausages and ColdRush's shaved ice with bold flavors. Concessions also feature classic concert bites like popcorn and nachos, alongside a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The accessible entrance is at the Main Entry Gate on the left side, closest to the Box Office. Assistive listening works through Listen Everywhere on your phone and headphones, or get a receiver from Guest Services with a photo ID. Buy accessible seats online at livenation.com by looking for the accessible logo, since day-of seating is limited.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is open Wednesdays and Fridays from 12pm to 4pm. On show days it opens at 12pm and usually closes 30 minutes after the final act takes the stage. Email JLLboxoffice@livenation.com with box office questions.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Jiffy Lube Live. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
